name: Ainmhícon
description: Ainmhícon (pronounced "An-Vee-Con") is an annual Irish furry convention held in Dublin. Its name combines the Irish word "ainmhí", meaning animal, with "con". Planning began in 2025 and the first convention was held on April 11 to 12, 2026, at the Clayton Hotel Liffey Valley. It is run by Ainmhícon CLG, a company limited by guarantee registered in Ireland. The convention does not host guests of honor and has no artist alley or fursuit parade. Programming includes opening and closing ceremonies, a dealers' den, a charity auction and karaoke. Its mascots are Craic and Ceol, a pair of shapeshifting púcaí.
